title: Azusawa Kohane — Profile Story

rows.Line: Weekend Garage
Weekend Garage Stage

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Okay, I'm ready to begin whenever...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I always get nervous when I talk with the audience, but I should take this time to practice for the sake of our events...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: So, here I go...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Hello, everyone.
I'm Kohane Azusawa from Vivid BAD SQUAD!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Thank you for coming to see our event today!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: We know you're all looking forward to seeing a good show, so we promise to sing with everything we have from start to finish!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Huh? That was cool...?
An, no... Now I feel embarrassed...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
But I appreciate the compliment.
I doubt I would've been able to do this before...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh, right...
I should talk about the old me.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I used to not have any confidence in myself...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I didn't have any talents or dreams like everyone else around me...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But a part of me desperately wanted all that to change.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Then, one day, I wandered into this city and met everybody here.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: They were all serious about singing and pursuing their dreams, which I thought was really cool...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: That was also when I learned about RAD WEEKEND, the event they were all hoping to surpass someday...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: And a lot happened after we decided to surpass RAD WEEKEND together.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: We had our share of troubles, but also received help from so many others along the way...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
But now, I feel proud of who I am.
I have confidence as a singer.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: My teammates, friends and this city have given me so much. And I'll cherish it all forever.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I'm so glad that I found this city and decided to start singing. Which is why...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: We're going to surpass RAD WEEKEND.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: For all those who've given us so much, and most of all, for myself...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I'll make sure we surpass it!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: H-How did I do...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
I did really well...?
Hehe. Thanks, you guys!
